Info

Who we areWe are the tech powerhouse behind Kaufland’s international online marketplaces and a company within the Schwarz Group. Through innovative technical developments, they not only create an outstanding shopping experience but also lay the foundation for an optimal selling experience for our sellers. Learn more about our division, areas, and cross-functional teams here!


Aufgaben

Your tasks – this is what awaits you in detail

  • You explore and experiment with emerging technologies, AI-driven tools, and novel architectural/MarTech approaches to shape the future of our B2B platform


Profil

  • Free choice of hardware: Mac or Lenovo, it's up to you

  • This is who we are: Our dynamic culture combines flat hierarchies, a start-up mentality, an international team of over 65 nationalities, and the strength of the Schwarz Group to provide you an agile and secure working environment.
  • We are team players: From day one, you will connect not only with your team but also with others through our digital onboarding journey, the buddy program, and regular team and company events, all-hands meetings, powerful mornings, and much more!
Check out our Principles & our blog for even more insights into our company culture!

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager - Martech
Senior Product Manager (Licensing & Billing)
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to make it simple and reliable for customers to buy, pay for, and grow their use of n8n. You'll own the foundations of how n8n's commercial system works: licensing and entitlements, customer accounts, and the metering and billing platform for both Cloud and Enterprise. Today these live across several teams and two billing stacks; you'll bring them into one stable home that the rest of the company builds on.

This is a foundations role. You build the system that pricing and packaging decisions run on, rather than running price experiments yourself. To do so, here are your core responsibilities:

OWN THE LICENSING & BILLING STRATEGY & ROADMAP

  • Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for Licensing & Billing in partnership with Engineering, Product leadership, Finance, and go-to-market.

  • Prioritize foundational investments based on revenue integrity, enterprise needs, data correctness, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs explicit.

  • Lead discovery with enterprise customers, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and RevOps to understand how n8n is bought, renewed, and grown today, and where that breaks.

LICENSING, ENTITLEMENTS & ACCOUNTS

  • Own the license server and entitlement model: issuance, renewal, and validation across Cloud, self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments, with one source of truth for which plan or deal grants which features.

  • Introduce "account" as a first-class product primitive (accounts, purchases, license keys, activations) and expose it as the API contract our customer-facing console and multi-instance management are built on.

  • Productize the deal-to-entitlement flow so a closed deal in Salesforce creates or updates entitlements without manual steps.

METERING & BILLING PLATFORM

  • Own usage metering and billing for Cloud and Enterprise, including subscription billing: what counts as a billable execution, quota consumption, and overage charging.

  • Lead the migration off Paddle Classic and unify Cloud and Enterprise billing into one platform.

  • Build the mechanics for usage-based enterprise billing and reliable overage charging.

CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

  • Make the architecture and mechanism decisions (entitlement model, billing platform, enterprise invoicing path) and align closely with Finance and go-to-market on each of them. Every decision here touches money; you bring people along rather than inform them afterwards.

  • Hold clear boundaries with adjacent teams: the customer console, execution limits, and access control live elsewhere; you own the data and mechanics they rely on.

  • Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • Billing or licensing product experience: You have 6+ years in Product, with a substantial part spent owning a billing, licensing, entitlement, or quote-to-cash system at a B2B SaaS company.

  • Shipped through Finance and RevOps: You've driven a cross-functional systems change where Finance, Sales Ops, and Engineering all had a say, and you got it live.

  • Systems and data-model depth: You can design or critique an entity model, reason about reconciliation and idempotency in a sync, read an API contract, and explain why two systems reading the same events end up with different numbers.

  • Attention to detail: You know that if the billing data is wrong, everything built on it inherits the error, and you sequence work accordingly.

  • Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or data-quality work to commercial outcomes.

  • Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.

  • Exceptional communication: You're equally at home with engineers, the Finance team, and Sales, and you can make billing trade-offs legible to all of them.

  • Enterprise reality: You understand what self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments mean for licensing and metering.

Nice-to-haves

  • Usage-based billing: You've owned usage-based or hybrid (subscription plus usage) billing.

  • Vendor billing stacks: You've worked hands-on with Paddle, Stripe, Chargebee, Zuora or similar, and know where they break at enterprise contract volume.

  • Migration experience: You've run a billing-provider migration.

  • Hands-on ability: You can read code, query data, or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.

  • CRM integration: You've worked on Salesforce or CRM-to-billing integrations.

  • Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, agent orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.

  • Writing culture: You default to writing things down to create clarity and alignment.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll be in the middle of the AI revolution. The shift from deterministic automation to agent autonomy is a genuinely open design space, and n8n has a credible claim to owning it. Every plan we sell, every enterprise contract, and every agent run that gets metered and billed runs on the foundation you own: licensing, entitlements, accounts, and the billing platform across Cloud and Enterprise. Your work directly shapes how n8n makes money and how easily customers can buy, grow, and trust what they pay for, from self-serve Cloud to air-gapped and OEM deployments.

You'll join one of Europe's fastest growing startups at the sweet spot: small enough to have real impact and be empowered, big enough that your work already reaches massive scale and serious enterprise customers. You'll work with experienced engineers, Finance, and go-to-market on problems where the details are the product, in an AI-native, empowered culture of humble, kind, yet driven and direct people, where you're hired to think, not just to execute. And with our fair-code model, a passionate open-source community gives you a direct feedback loop on everything you ship.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now, and help us build the commercial foundation of the future of reliable AI automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

* Country-specific details are provided in your contract.

Job Title: Project Manager - Software Implementation (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Project Managers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:

  

  • Lead the planning and implementation of software projects related to system connections with our customers, ensuring they are delivered on time and within scope. 

  • Maintain and update project plans, proactively identifying and managing any project risks. 

  • Ensure the availability of the right expertise for each project phase, coordinating with internal and external resources as necessary. 

  • Manage stakeholder expectations, delivering regular and comprehensive project updates and effectively resolving any arising issues. 

  • Contribute to the standardization of project implementation methodology and project templates to improve project standardization and efficiency. 

  • Generate thorough Project/Solution Documentation, outlining project goals, deliverables, and timelines. 

  • Handle all customer communication across various projects, ensuring clear, consistent, and timely communication with all stakeholders. 


  • Master's degree in project management or related technical field required. 

  • Background in Electronics/Electricals

  • Professional Project Management Certification from an accredited institution preferred. 

  • Demonstrated understanding of Project Management processes, strategies, and methods 

  • Excellent time management and organizational skills and experience establishing guidelines in these areas for others. 

  • 3+ years of Project management experience in the field of software implementations 

  • Experience with complex data projects where a systematic approach is crucial to success. 

  • Dexterity with software tools and data manipulation & analysis 

  • A creative mind that can think outside the box. 

  • Curiosity to find disruptive as opposed to incremental solutions to challenging data problems. 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here

jobs.title: Product Manager (Atomic Team)
jobs.description:
About us

Smallpdf was founded in 2013 with one simple belief: working with documents shouldn’t be complicated. Today, we’re an industry leader in digital document solutions, trusted by millions of users across 195+ countries. We build intuitive, powerful tools that help individuals and businesses work smarter with their documents. From compressing and converting files to editing and e-signing, our platform makes complex document workflows simple, secure, and accessible.

As a product-led company headquartered in Switzerland and powered by a diverse, global team from 35+ countries, we combine product excellence with a strong focus on user experience, data-driven decision-making and continuous innovation. We operate at the intersection of simplicity and performance, building scalable solutions that power everyday productivity for individuals and businesses alike. Our team is driven by ownership, experimentation and a shared commitment to delivering meaningful impact at scale.

About the role

Over 60 million people use Smallpdf every month to do one thing: compress a file, convert it, translate it, merge it. Our core tools are freemium and SEO-led: people find us through Google and, more and more, through AI assistants. They finish the job and leave.

As Product Manager for our core tools, you make that single task the fastest, easiest and best on the market, so search engines, AI assistants and people send users back. You own the individual tools end to end. Together with our growth team, you work on the channels that bring people to them: organic search, paid search and AI search. You work in Zurich with a fully staffed product team, including an EM, a designer and engineering counterparts, and closely with our SEO, growth and marketing teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own the individual tools end to end: upload experience, processing, output quality, download

  • Work with our SEO, SEM and growth teams on how people reach the tools, including positioning with marketing so people remember us by name

  • Help turn AI search and LLMs into a real acquisition channel, from first users to a tracked source of traffic

  • Ship AI features where they help users, with a clear process for accuracy, cost and quality before launch

  • Design, monitor and analyse experiments on millions of sessions, and ship, iterate or kill on the result

  • Run deep analyses and user research yourself, and be the voice of the user in every decision

jobs.title: Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking a product manager to own the "what" and "why" of our quantum sensing measurement systems. You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1. You sit between our customers (foundries, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs) and every engineering discipline, and you make sure we build the right product in the right order.


Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.


Why join us?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.
  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.
  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.
  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.
Still unsure about why joining us?
  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.
  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.
  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.
  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.
Let’s make the invisible visible!


What will you do

  • Own the product requirements: gather needs from customers, the field, the market, and internal stakeholders (serviceability, modularity and product configuration, manufacturability, and cost targets), and turn them into clear, prioritized, solution-neutral requirements.
  • Establish our requirements engineering tooling and workflow: select and set up how we capture, trace, and maintain requirements, from customer need through specification to verification, including change control across releases. This is a foundational task in your first months.
  • Own and maintain the QDm.1 roadmap: propose what gets built and in what order, make the trade-offs explicit, and align decisions with the management team.
  • Work with the applications team on customer interactions and evaluations with fabs, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs, and translate what you learn into requirements.
  • For each requirement, define acceptance criteria from the customer's point of view so it is clear and testable when the need is met, and link them to customer evaluation and qualification plans.
  • Align with the Product Development department on scope and timing, and hand solution-neutral requirements into engineering: state the need and the why, and leave the how to the disciplines.
  • Support go-to-market: give input on positioning, pricing, launch readiness, and documentation scope together with the applications, operations, and product development teams.


What is expected of you

  • Several years in product management for complex hardware or capital equipment, ideally in semiconductor, metrology, or a comparable deep-tech environment.
  • A track record of writing clear product requirements that engineering can actually build from.
  • The ability to talk to both customers and engineers and to translate between them.
  • Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation with the people designing the product, across mechanics, optics, electronics/RF, and software.
  • Structured prioritization: you make trade-offs explicit and back them with reasoning.
  • We hire for demonstrated skill rather than a specific degree; a technical or scientific background is typical. The working language is English.
Additional experience we value:
  • Semiconductor industry knowledge (fabs, IDMs, OSATs, inspection, metrology, or failure analysis).
  • Familiarity with SEMI standards and fab tool integration (for example, S2/S8, E10, SECS/GEM).
  • Experience selecting or setting up a requirements management tool (for example, Jama, Polarion, or CodeBeamer).
  • A working understanding of quantum sensing, optics, or precision instrumentation.


Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.
  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.
  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.
  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.
  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.
  • Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.
  • Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Hardware & Edge AI (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
New Challenge

About Us
Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a defence technology company with offices in Berlin and Munich, and a trusted partner of the German Armed Forces. Our customers field sensors, drones and C2 systems from many vendors that were never built to work together. We build Hydris, an orchestration layer that integrates the systems they already field, and the ones they'll add next, into one picture operators can act on across defence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Hydris runs at the edge, keeps working when the link drops, and its core is open source under Apache 2.0.

As Senior Product Manager for Mission Devices, you'll own the hardware that puts Hydris in the field. 

You'll work end-to-end, from discovery with operators through hardware build cycles to fielded units, and you'll decide what gets built rather than work through someone else's backlog. The bar is concrete: devices that run for months off-grid in contested RF environments.

What you'll do
Discovery and requirements

  • Spend time with end users in their operating environment to understand their workflows in depth, not just their stated requirements.
  • Validate assumptions about value, usability, feasibility and viability through prototypes, bench tests and field trials before committing to hardware fabrication.
  • Analyze contractual specifications with Program Managers, separating firm constraints from areas where there's room for the best technical solution.
Roadmap and delivery
  • Maintain an outcome-focused roadmap aligned to hardware build cycles (EVT/DVT/PVT), firmware releases and OTA update pipelines.
  • Define requirements and field metrics for each device, including detection performance, energy efficiency, mission endurance and SWaP, and make the trade-offs between them.
  • Prioritize investment across the device family, deciding where to extend existing devices and where a new one is needed.
Systems and interoperability
  • Make sure devices integrate with Hydris as and interoperate with third-party systems through industry standards and protocols.
  • Design provisioning, commissioning and deployment workflows that are simple and reliable in the field.
  • Investigate issues that span hardware, firmware and communications, and work with engineering to resolve them.
Collaboration
  • Act as the main source of product context and the product's champion, making sure the team, leadership and customers understand what we're building and why.
  • Work in a product trio with engineering (hardware and ML) and design. 
  • Partner with Program and Capture Managers to keep the product vision aligned with contractual commitments.
  • Write clear PRDs and decision records, and mentor teammates on discovery practice and hardware–software trade-offs.

You should apply if you have
  • 5+ years of product management experience with hardware–software products, for example in embedded systems, IoT, robotics, defence systems or edge AI.
  • Experience taking a connected hardware product from EVT/DVT through production into operational use, including in-field updates.
  • Experience running product development end to end, from discovery to engineering-ready work, and the ability to adapt to however a team works.
  • Ability making decisions with incomplete information, and the judgment to know when a decision is risky enough to slow down.
  • Clear communication with hardware engineers, ML researchers and operators alike.
  • Motivation to contribute to European security and sovereignty.
  • Willingness to travel regularly to military exercises, test ranges and customer sites in Germany and NATO partner countries, sometimes in demanding field conditions.
  • Eligibility for German security clearance (SÜ2).
  • Fluency in German and English (C1 or higher).
You'd be a particularly great fit with
  • A degree in electrical, mechanical or systems engineering, robotics or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience bringing hardware products from prototype to production.
  • Experience in military, public safety or other mission-critical operational environments.
  • Exposure to sensor fusion, mesh networking or degraded RF environments, including familiarity with interoperability standards such as Cursor on Target, SAPIENT, ONVIF or ASTERIX.

We Offer
  • Direct feedback from the field: you'll see the products you build tested in real operating environments by the people who use them.
  • Prime Berlin-Mitte location – right between Alexanderplatz and Hackescher Markt.
  • High degree of autonomy and ownership, and flat structure.
  • Annual €1500 Learning & development budget  (available after probation).
  • Bike Leasing and Urban Sports Club membership.
  • 30 days of paid time off.

Note: We're unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role – candidates must already be eligible to work in Germany.

Gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering Manager sowie einem stream-aligned Team aus Designern und Entwicklern gestaltest du digitale Produkte und Workflows, die unseren Kundenservice einfacher, schneller und skalierbarer machen.

Kundenbedürfnisse verstehen

  • Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden, sowie unserer Teams aus Customer-Support und Claims Management und übersetzt diese in relevante Produktprobleme und -chancen
  • Du analysierst Nutzerverhalten, Kundenfeedback, operative Daten und Business-Kennzahlen, um Verbesserungspotenziale zu identifizieren
 Produktvision & Impact
  • Du entwickelst eine Produktvision und entsprechende Strategien für dein Produktgebiet und leitest daraus konkrete Ziele und Initiativen ab
  • Du definierst geeignete Produktmetriken und Erfolgskriterien und steuerst dein Produkt über messbare Outcomes. 
  • Du priorisierst eigenständig dein Product Backlog und übernimmst die Product-Owner-Verantwortung für dein stream-aligned Team. Du verantwortest nicht nur die Auslieferung von Features, sondern auch deren Impact
Prozesse und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung
  • Du identifizierst Möglichkeiten für Automatisierungen und AI, um manuelle Arbeit zu reduzieren und Agents bei der Bearbeitung von Kundenanliegen zu unterstützen
  • Du koordinierst die Weiterentwicklung deines Produktes mit relevanten Stakeholdern
  • Du hilfst dabei, unsere Product- und Arbeitsweisen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und stärkst eine Kultur, in der wir über Outcomes statt Output sprechen

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung als Product Manager, Product Owner oder in einer vergleichbaren Produktrolle und hast bereits Verantwortung für ein digitales Produkt oder ein komplexes Produktgebiet übernommen
  • Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und kannst auch komplexe Sachverhalte sicher, präzise und adressatengerecht auf verschiedenen Ebenen kommunizieren
  • Du bringst Know-How in agiler Produktentwicklung (z.B. Scrum, Kanban) mit - Discovery und Delivery sind keine neuen Begriffe für dich
  • Du interessierst dich für Automatisierung und AI, erkennst deren Potenzial für digitale Produkte und operative Prozesse und nutzt das so für deine Leidenschaft für digitale Nutzererfahrungen
  • Du behältst das Wesentliche im Blick, geht’s pragmatisch und Lösungsorientiert an deine Aufgaben heran und verfügst über eine ausgeprägte Organisationsstärke
  • Du bist analytisch und zahlengetrieben und hast eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • Du kannst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern aus Business, Operations, Tech und Legal arbeiten

Unsere Vielfalt ist eine Stärke, denn sie macht das ottonova-Team kreativer und produktiver. jobs.title: Senior Project Manager für digitale Verwaltungsprojekte - Migration und Inneres (all genders)
jobs.description:
Über ]init[

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.


Deine Mission bei ]init[

Du willst Digitalisierung dort vorantreiben, wo sie gesellschaftlich wirklich zählt? Als Senior Project Manager (all genders) gestaltest und steuerst du anspruchsvolle digitale Verwaltungsprojekte rund um Migration & Inneres. Du bringst Kund:innen, Fachlichkeit und Technologie zusammen und machst aus komplexen Anforderungen digitale Lösungen, die in der Praxis funktionieren.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du realisierst anspruchsvolle IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte von gesellschaftlicher Relevanz mit besonderem Fokus auf die Fachthemen Migration & Inneres – agil oder hybrid.
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte über die gesamte Projektlaufzeit und steuerst Scope, Time, Budget, Qualität und Risiken.
  • Du arbeitest mit interdisziplinäre Projektteams, in unterschiedlichen technologischen Kontexten – von digitalen Verwaltungsleistungen und Fachanwendungen über Content- und Formular-Management-Systeme bis hin zu individuellen IT-Lösungen zusammen und sorgst für eine strukturierte und verlässliche Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des Projekts.
  • Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinierst du interne und externe Stakeholder und arbeitest eng mit unseren Kund:innen aus der öffentlichen Verwaltung zusammen. Gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams übersetzt du die Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen in tragfähige IT-Lösungen und digitale Prozesse und begleitest deren Umsetzung von der Konzeption bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live.
  • Du begleitest unsere Kund:innen bei Fragestellungen rund um die digitale Transformation und erkennst dabei auch Potenziale für die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Projekte und Lösungen.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement von  Entwicklungs- oder Digitalisierungsprojekten und kannst Projekte eigenständig und Ende-zu-Ende steuern.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung interdisziplinärer Projektteams und übernimmst sicher Verantwortung für Scope, Budget, Time,  Qualität und Risiken.
  • Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung mit Digitalisierungsprojekten der öffentlichen Verwaltung und/oder einen fachlichen Bezug zu den Themen Migration & Inneres mit.
  • Du kennst und schätzt die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Kund:innen und verstehst Projektmanagement als kundenorientierte Delivery-Rolle und bewegst dich mit deinem Kommunikationsgeschick souverän auf unterschiedlichen Ebenen der Projektorganisation.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit agilen und/oder klassischen Projektmethoden. Erfahrung mit skalierten agilen Vorgehensweisen oder hybriden Projekt-Set-ups ist ein Plus.
  • Idealerweise verfügst du über eine relevante Projektmanagement- oder Agile-Zertifizierung, z. B. PRINCE2, PMI, Scrum PSM/PSPO
  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium bildet die fachliche Grundlage für deine Tätigkeit bei uns.
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit.


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.


Werde Teil des Teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.
Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.
 
Da uns und unseren Kund:innen Sicherheit wichtig ist, kann je nach Position nach einer Zusage eine vertrauliche Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich sein.


Recruiter

Anne Kroll

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.


Deine Mission bei ]init[

Du willst Digitalisierung dort vorantreiben, wo sie gesellschaftlich wirklich zählt? Als Senior Project Manager (all genders) gestaltest und steuerst du anspruchsvolle digitale Verwaltungsprojekte rund um Migration & Inneres. Du bringst Kund:innen, Fachlichkeit und Technologie zusammen und machst aus komplexen Anforderungen digitale Lösungen, die in der Praxis funktionieren.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du realisierst anspruchsvolle IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte von gesellschaftlicher Relevanz mit besonderem Fokus auf die Fachthemen Migration & Inneres – agil oder hybrid.
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte über die gesamte Projektlaufzeit und steuerst Scope, Time, Budget, Qualität und Risiken.
  • Du arbeitest mit interdisziplinäre Projektteams, in unterschiedlichen technologischen Kontexten – von digitalen Verwaltungsleistungen und Fachanwendungen über Content- und Formular-Management-Systeme bis hin zu individuellen IT-Lösungen zusammen und sorgst für eine strukturierte und verlässliche Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des Projekts.
  • Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinierst du interne und externe Stakeholder und arbeitest eng mit unseren Kund:innen aus der öffentlichen Verwaltung zusammen. Gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams übersetzt du die Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen in tragfähige IT-Lösungen und digitale Prozesse und begleitest deren Umsetzung von der Konzeption bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live.
  • Du begleitest unsere Kund:innen bei Fragestellungen rund um die digitale Transformation und erkennst dabei auch Potenziale für die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Projekte und Lösungen.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement von  Entwicklungs- oder Digitalisierungsprojekten und kannst Projekte eigenständig und Ende-zu-Ende steuern.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung interdisziplinärer Projektteams und übernimmst sicher Verantwortung für Scope, Budget, Time,  Qualität und Risiken.
  • Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung mit Digitalisierungsprojekten der öffentlichen Verwaltung und/oder einen fachlichen Bezug zu den Themen Migration & Inneres mit.
  • Du kennst und schätzt die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Kund:innen und verstehst Projektmanagement als kundenorientierte Delivery-Rolle und bewegst dich mit deinem Kommunikationsgeschick souverän auf unterschiedlichen Ebenen der Projektorganisation.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit agilen und/oder klassischen Projektmethoden. Erfahrung mit skalierten agilen Vorgehensweisen oder hybriden Projekt-Set-ups ist ein Plus.
  • Idealerweise verfügst du über eine relevante Projektmanagement- oder Agile-Zertifizierung, z. B. PRINCE2, PMI, Scrum PSM/PSPO
  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium bildet die fachliche Grundlage für deine Tätigkeit bei uns.
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit.


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.


Werde Teil des Teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.
Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.
 
Da uns und unseren Kund:innen Sicherheit wichtig ist, kann je nach Position nach einer Zusage eine vertrauliche Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich sein.


Recruiter

Anne Kroll

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Self-Service & Onboarding
jobs.description:
HEADLINE:

Job Title: Senior Product Manager, Self-Service & Onboarding
Reporting to: Head of Product
Location: London - Hybrid-Working: 3 days in office, 2 days from home


ABOUT THE ROLE:

APEXX is pioneering payment orchestration, transforming the global payments landscape with cutting-edge technology and innovation. As a leader in Fintech, we're committed to excellence, driving forward-thinking solutions that empower businesses worldwide.

We are looking for a Product Manager to own APEXX's Self-Service & Onboarding domain. You will define and execute the product strategy that enables customers to onboard, configure, manage, and optimise their use of APEXX services independently, creating a scalable self-service experience that gives customers greater control and accelerates time-to-value.

This is a highly cross-functional role working across Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Customer Success, and Compliance to create scalable digital experiences that improve customer satisfaction and business efficiency.

You will own the end-to-end onboarding journey - from account creation and KYC/KYB orchestration to payment provider configuration, user management, and self-service administration - as part of a broader vision to give customers greater control over how they configure, manage, and optimise their use of the APEXX platform.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for APEXX's self-service capabilities and Customer Portal, starting with the end-to-end merchant onboarding experience and progressively expanding customer control across the platform.

  • Evolve the APEXX Customer Portal into a high-performing, intuitive, and flexible platform that enables customers to understand their payments through actionable data-driven insights and recommendations, and take meaningful actions directly within the platform.

  • Design and deliver scalable self-service capabilities spanning merchant onboarding, account and user administration, API credential management, payment provider configuration, routing rules, and wider platform configuration.

  • Drive Product-Led Growth initiatives that increase adoption of APEXX capabilities, enable customers to expand their use of the platform, and unlock new commercial and market opportunities.

  • Use customer research, product analytics, and experimentation to understand complex enterprise needs, identify opportunities, prioritise roadmap investments, and measure customer and business outcomes.

  • Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Commercial, Customer Success, Compliance, and Operations to translate customer needs and product strategy into secure, scalable, performant, and intuitive experiences.

  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI to simplify complex workflows, automate repetitive processes, surface actionable insights and recommendations, and provide intelligent in-product guidance.

ABOUT YOU:

  • Proven track record in Product Management within SaaS, platform, fintech, or similarly complex digital products, with end-to-end ownership from discovery and strategy through delivery and measurable outcomes.

  • Experience owning and delivering sophisticated customer-facing portals, self-service capabilities, onboarding journeys, or platform configuration products, ideally within complex enterprise environments.

  • Strong product and systems thinking, with the ability to turn complex customer and operational workflows into intuitive, scalable, and reusable product capabilities.

  • Strong understanding of Product-Led Growth, with experience using product capabilities and customer experience to drive adoption, expansion, and commercial growth.

  • Strong analytical and data-driven approach, with experience using customer research, product analytics, and experimentation to inform decisions, prioritise effectively, and measure outcomes.

  • Strong product judgement and commercial awareness, with the ability to balance customer needs, business outcomes, technical constraints, and long-term platform scalability when making product decisions.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to create clarity, influence decisions, and work effectively across Engineering, Design, Commercial, Customer Success, Compliance, and Operations.

  • Experience in payments, fintech, or financial services would be highly advantageous.

 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

Great people deserve great rewards. We believe in recognising the impact you make with competitive compensation and benefits that support you both at work and beyond.

Whether it's taking time to recharge, looking after your health, working from somewhere new, or investing in your growth, we've built a benefits package designed to help you thrive, because when our people do well, so does APEXX.

💰 Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries that recognise your skills, experience, and the impact you make.

🏖️ Generous Time Off: Take the time you need to rest and recharge with annual leave, public holidays, and wellbeing-focused time away from work.

🌍 Work From Anywhere: Enjoy the flexibility to work remotely from eligible locations for up to 90 days per year, subject to our Work From Anywhere policy.*

❤️ Comprehensive Health Insurance: Your wellbeing matters. We provide comprehensive health insurance which includes optical & dental to help support you when it matters most.

🛡️ Life Insurance & Critical Illness Protection: Additional protection for you and your loved ones when it’s needed most.

👶 Enhanced Family Leave: Supporting you through life's biggest milestones with enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies.

📈 Learning & Growth: We're invested in your development, with opportunities to learn, grow, and build a meaningful career at APEXX.

WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE:

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams across the UK & India, helping enterprise businesses simplify the complexity of payments. For more than a decade, we've been building technology that enables merchants to connect to the world's payment ecosystem through a single, scalable integration.

Our platform gives businesses access to 200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods, and 10+ Buy Now, Pay Later providers, helping them optimise payment performance, improve acceptance rates, and expand into new markets with confidence.

Trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon, and Jet2, we're redefining enterprise payments by making them smarter, faster, and more reliable.

As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities to make an impact. Whether you're building products, solving complex engineering challenges, or supporting the teams behind them, you'll play a meaningful role in shaping the future of global payments at APEXX.

To learn more about APEXX and experience the dynamics of being part of our team, feel free to check out the provided media channels below:

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/apexxglobal/

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/apexx.global/?hl=en

Main Website: https://apexx.global/

APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to encouraging equality, diversity, and inclusion among our employees and eliminating discrimination.

We do not accept speculative CVs or candidate profiles from Recruitment Agencies.

jobs.title: Product Manager Intern
jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

 We're looking for a curious Product Manager Intern to join our team and contribute to the evolution of Aircall's core product. You'll work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data, Design and Go-to-market to turn customer feedback into product improvements, align on tradeoffs across teams, and help shape the experience our customers rely on every day.
This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys talking to customers, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and likes untangling problems that cut across multiple product areas. to join our team and contribute to the evolution of Aircall's core product. You'll work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data, Design and Go-to-market to turn customer feedback into product improvements, align on tradeoffs across teams, and help shape the experience our customers rely on every day.
This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys talking to customers, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and likes untangling problems that cut across multiple product areas.

Key Responsibilities :
Customer Insights & Product Development
  • Meet directly with customers to gather feedback, discuss pain points, and validate potential improvements.
  • Synthesize qualitative and quantitative feedback into clear opportunities, and translate them into product recommendations that shape the roadmap.
  • Partner with Product, Design and Engineering to define requirements and prioritize enhancements that improve user experience and agent efficiency.
  • Align dependencies and facilitate tradeoff discussions with stakeholders across product areas.
  • Follow the development cycle end-to-end to ensure we ship the best possible experience in an agile manner.
  • Contribute to Knowledge Base articles, FAQs and product demos to support launches and go-to-market.


    • Product Analysis & Optimization
  • Gather and synthesize usage and performance data from multiple sources (interaction logs, analytics, customer feedback).
  • Identify patterns, bottlenecks and opportunities in product workflows, and turn them into more intuitive experiences.
  • Use modern data tools and, where relevant, AI/LLM-based approaches to enrich analysis and uncover deeper insights.


    • Monitoring & Performance
  • Research, recommend and help implement tools and frameworks for tracking key product metrics (e.g. latency, reliability, usability).
  • Collaborate with teams to define and monitor KPIs aligned with product goals.
  • Help set up dashboards, alerts and reports to support ongoing performance evaluation and decision-making.

    • Qualifications :
  • Master's student from an engineering or business school or university.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Comfortable running customer conversations — asking good questions, listening carefully, and following up.
  • Comfortable working across teams, aligning dependencies and navigating tradeoffs with peers and stakeholders.
  • A first experience (internship) in a product or project team is a plus.
  • Knowledge of SaaS, product development cycles, and our business is a plus.
    • Why join us?

    🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities
    💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
    📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit

jobs.title: Senior Data Product Manager - Growth
jobs.description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

The Engineering & Data team builds innovative tech products and platforms to support the impressive growth of their gaming and consumer apps which allow Voodoo to stay at the forefront of the mobile gaming industry.

As a Senior Data Product Manager, you will be joining the BI/Prediction Team which is an autonomous squad of around 10 people, delivering best-in-class predictive solutions using Machine Learning algorithms for our growth operations. The team is composed of top-tier data scientists and analysts.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Product Manager who is deeply passionate about machine learning and data-intensive products, leveraging among the largest datasets available in the industry. You will play a crucial role in building ML prediction products for our growth operations while working in direct cooperation with our Prediction Tech Lead.

  • Drive and own product vision, strategy and roadmap, guide feature prioritization and scope.

  • Conduct discovery with growth and other stakeholders (e.g., Gaming) to anticipate business needs and detail the specifications for the tech team.

  • Coordinate new product releases (e.g., prediction for a new app), assess impact and collect users feedback.

  • Address stakeholders questions/feedback, onboard them on the product, perform analysis, and flag key prediction/analytics issues to tech.

  • Collaborate with external partners (e.g., networks, MMM) on prediction projects, and identify new opportunities via benchmarking.

  • Stay updated on privacy topics (e.g., Privacy Sandbox, ATT) through monitoring and testing.

  • Support the tech team by identifying new organizational tools and processes to improve efficiency.

  • Act as the main point of contact for top management on deliveries and decisions

  • Apply analytical thinking to continuously evaluate and improve product performance

Profile

  • Extensive proven experience as a Product Manager in the tech industry

  • Data analyst or Data Scientist background is a strong plus

  • Value-driven, data-driven, and open-minded problem solver

  • Great communicator and a team player, who likes to drive results together.

  • You are fluent in English and have a French conversational level.

  • Interest in gaming and mobile apps

Benefits

  • Competitive salary upon experience

  • Swile Lunch vouchers

  • Gymlib (100% borne by Voodoo)

  • Premium healthcare coverage SideCare, for your family is 100% borne by Voodoo

  • Child day care facilities (Les Petits Chaperons rouges)

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

  • Flexible vacation policy

  • Remote days

jobs.title: (Senior) Project Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Als (Senior) Projekt Manager (m/w/d) behältst Du auch in komplexen Web- und Digitalprojekten den Überblick – insbesondere in anspruchsvollen Umfeldern mit Behörden, öffentlichen Auftraggebern oder großen Konzernen. Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden, steuerst Anforderungen, Stakeholder und Teams und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte strukturiert, termingerecht und wirtschaftlich erfolgreich umgesetzt werden. Dabei überzeugst Du durch Professionalität, Verbindlichkeit und einen pragmatischen Blick auf das Wesentliche.


Unser Angebot

  • Gestaltungsspielräume in vielseitigen und spannenden Digital-Projekten für namhafte Kunden
  • Unbefristete Festanstellung mit viel Eigenverantwortung und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Moderne IT-Infrastruktur und modernes Tooling
  • Flache Hierarchien und offene Kommunikation
  • Gesunde Work-Life-Balance durch flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne Kernzeit sowie die Möglichkeit zum hybriden Arbeiten
  • Angenehmes Arbeitsklima mit kompetenten und sympathischen Kollegen
  • Möglichkeiten zur individuellen, dekorativen und technischen Gestaltung Deines Arbeitsplatzes
  • Zentrale Lage inmitten der Digitalmetropole Berlin
  • Add-Ons: Dachterrasse, Kicker, Vergünstigungen, kostenfreie Getränke (Kaffee, Tee, Wasser, Softdrinks), Team- und Firmenevents, etc.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest, planst, koordinierst und steuerst Online-Projekte in komplexen Stakeholder-Umfeldern für Behörden, öffentliche Auftraggeber und Unternehmen
  • Du begleitest unsere Kunden von der Strategieanalyse über die Implementierung bis hin zum späteren IT-Betrieb und dessen kontinuierlicher Optimierung
  • Du verantwortest die Zielerreichung sowie die Überwachung von Terminen, Ressourcen, Kosten und der Wirtschaftlichkeit.
  • Du führst ein interdisziplinäres Team aus Entwicklern, Test-/DevOps-Engineers sowie ggf. UX/UI-Experten und stellst eine effektive Zusammenarbeit aller Disziplinen sicher
  • Du unterstützt bei der Akquise neuer Projekte und wirkst an der Entwicklung maßgeschneiderter Angebote für unsere Kunden mit


Dein Profil

Du fühlst Dich in der Welt digitaler Online-Projekte zu Hause und bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Leitung und Steuerung von Web- und Digitalprojekten mit. Idealerweise hast Du bereits erfolgreich Web-, Portal- oder CMS-Projekte für Behörden, öffentliche Auftraggeber oder große Konzernstrukturen umgesetzt und kennst die damit verbundenen Anforderungen an Kommunikation, Governance und Projektsteuerung. Methoden wie Scrum, SAFe sowie klassische Projektmanagement-Ansätze setzt Du sicher und pragmatisch ein.. Du kommunizierst souverän auf Deutsch, trittst professionell gegenüber Kunden und Stakeholdern auf und übernimmst Verantwortung auch in anspruchsvollen Projektsituationen. Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

jobs.title: Impact Producer
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

jobs.title: Technical Web Specialist (12-month fixed term contract)
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

As a Technical Web Specialist, you’ll be the connective tissue between our web team and the rest of the business. This role exists because great websites aren’t just built — they’re coordinated, prioritised, and protected from chaos. Sitting at the intersection of Marketing and Web Development, you’ll own the intake and lifecycle of web requests, ensure every project is properly scoped before it touches the dev queue, and support the team in delivering an ambitious web roadmap.

But this role doesn’t stop at coordination. You’ll also be hands-on in the quality of what we ship — reviewing copy and UX before pages go live, supporting CRO initiatives, and acting as a critical second pair of eyes on every significant release. You care as much about whether a page converts as whether it launches on time.

If you’re someone who thrives on bringing order to complexity, understands how a website is actually built, and can hold your own in a room with developers, designers, and marketers alike, this is your role.


What You’ll Do

Technical Ownership & QA

  • Build and ship pages/components directly in Storyblok CMS: component configuration, staging, QA, and production deployment across market versions

  • QA every release technically — rendering, functionality, and cross-browser/device behaviour, not just copy and visual polish

  • Use AI tools as a core part of daily production work (drafting, layout variants, QA support), and know where AI output still needs a human check, particularly around localisation nuance and experiment validity

Request Triage & Scoping

  • Own intake for web requests: qualify, triage, and estimate technical complexity and dependencies before anything is scoped or scheduled

  • Enforce briefing standards and know enough technically to explain why a brief is incomplete

  • Decide what can be handled directly vs. what needs to go to the development team, and write specs the team can act on without excessive clarification

Project Coordination

  • Act as day-to-day PM between the development team and business stakeholders: track scope, delivery, and risk

  • Maintain the web backlog and sprint board with clear status, ownership, and blockers

  • Support CRO initiatives: help build A/B test setups, document hypotheses, and track experiment results

Process & Reporting

  • Maintain intake templates, briefing standards, and triage criteria

  • Produce regular status updates and pipeline reports for the Head of Web and wider leadership


What We’re Looking For

Must-haves

  • 2 to 4 years in a web operations, technical/digital project management, or web production role, ideally with hands-on CMS or front-end exposure — not purely marketing coordination

  • Working technical literacy: solid HTML/CSS fundamentals, understanding of how a CMS is structured (Storyblok, Contentful, Webflow or similar), staging vs. production workflows, and what a QA process actually checks

  • Comfortable using AI tools hands-on in production (prompting for drafts, QA’ing AI output) and able to articulate where AI isn’t reliable enough to trust unsupervised

  • Product/project-management instincts: can scope a request, size complexity, sequence competing priorities, and brief external developers with minimal hand-holding

  • Confident translating between technical and non-technical stakeholders, and comfortable pushing back on a brief or a deadline when needed

  • Strong written communication: a clear brief, a precise QA note, a concise status update

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Storyblok or a comparable headless CMS

  • Familiarity with web analytics or conversion tracking concepts

  • Exposure to A/B testing/CRO tools, or basic SQL

  • Experience briefing or QA’ing a development team

  • Basic understanding of Core Web Vitals / page performance

  • Familiarity with SEO fundamentals as they intersect with web production


What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12–16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 “Work from Anywhere” days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.title: Lead Fraud & AML Ops
jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 500,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Role context

Pennylane currently operates around 50,000 business accounts through a BaaS model with Swan and is applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licences. As we prepare to onboard new customers under our own licensed entity from mid-2027, we are building our first line of defence across onboarding, transaction monitoring, fraud and risk operations.

As Transaction Monitoring & Fraud Operations Lead, you will be one of the first operational leaders in this greenfield setup. Reporting to the Head of FinCrime Operations, you will lead first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations across Pennylane’s payment activities within a single team. You will own first-line alert handling and fraud case management, with clear escalation paths to Compliance and Risk.

Your mission will be to build and launch Pennylane’s first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations, then scale the team and its workflows as volumes grow—while maintaining strong decision quality, auditability and customer protection.

This is a high-autonomy role with direct exposure to a strategic regulatory project and close collaboration with Product, Compliance and Risk. You will help shape how Pennylane protects the financial activity of French SMEs as it brings more of its regulated operations in-house.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations for business customers, ensuring that alert triage, investigations, customer outreach and escalations are completed in line with policies set by Compliance and Risk and within agreed SLAs.

  • Translate AML/CFT and fraud policies into operational procedures, decision trees and analyst playbooks, and provide evidence-based recommendations on alert quality and operational bottlenecks.

  • Review complex or high-risk alerts within the first-line mandate, oversee post-onboarding fraud cases and ensure that escalations, customer complaints and law-enforcement requests are handled with complete, auditable records.

  • Implement the QA and reporting framework, monitor operational and risk indicators, and support Compliance during controls testing, audits and regulatory reviews.

  • Recruit, onboard and lead the transaction monitoring and fraud analyst team, combining hands-on support with effective coaching and a culture of rigour, accountability and continuous learning.

  • Establish the team’s performance and capacity framework, covering SLAs, productivity, quality, backlogs, false-positive rates and hiring needs.

  • Partner with Product and Tech to test and improve transaction-monitoring, fraud and back-office workflows, prioritising automation while identifying the controls and decisions that should remain manual.

First 6–12 months

  • Deliver approved operating procedures, analyst playbooks and escalation rules before go-live.

  • Establish a capacity and hiring plan based on observed alert volumes and handling times.

  • Validate that alert queues, evidence collection, account measures and second-line handovers work operationally before launch.

  • By go-live, have first-line monitoring operational for new customers, with trained coverage, agreed SLAs, documented QA controls and named escalation owners.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience in transaction monitoring, fraud or broader financial-crime operations within a regulated financial-services environment, including ownership of operational performance and complex case decisions.

  • Proven experience leading and developing an operational team responsible for alert queues or investigations, combining effective coaching with a hands-on player-coach approach when needed.

  • Strong understanding of first-line alert handling: triage, investigation, typology, escalation, and the difference between a fraud case and an AML case.

  • Good working knowledge of French and European AML/CFT expectations, including ACPR and TRACFIN requirements, and experience translating policy into SOPs, decision trees and analyst guidance.

  • Experience working with Product or Tech on workflow or tooling changes.

  • Sound judgement on what to automate, what to sample and what to escalate.

  • Ability to use operational metrics to manage quality, backlogs and capacity.

  • Ability to make structured, well-documented decisions under pressure and communicate complex cases clearly to operational and compliance stakeholders.

  • Comfort building operations in a greenfield environment where volumes are still uncertain and tooling is evolving.

  • Exposure to ACPR expectations, a licensing programme, a BaaS migration or law-enforcement requests would be an advantage.

Languages, presence and location

  • Fluent French and English are mandatory.

  • Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

  • Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role.

Why join

  • Build first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations for a new regulated entity from the ground up.

  • Shape the operating model before launch, rather than inheriting fixed processes and tooling.

  • Take ownership of a critical domain with a direct impact on go-live readiness, customer protection and responsible growth.

  • Work closely with Operations, Compliance, Risk, Product and Tech on a strategic company project.

Recruitment Process

1. Interview with Lucie (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Maxime (1h), General Manager

3. Case Study with Laurent and Léa (1h)

4. Last round with Stanislas and Felix (45 min)

 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote.
